scripts.lint: eslint . && npm run test:eslint-rules && tsc --noEmit && prettier --check './**/*.{ts,tsx}' && knip && syncpack lint && npm run generate:ui-catalog:check && npm run arch:check
scripts.arch:check: depcruise app components hooks lib src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs
scripts.arch:diagram: depcruise app components hooks lib src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type mermaid --collapse "^(app|components|lib|hooks|src)/[^/]+" --exclude "^node_modules"
scripts.generate:local: command -v buf >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "buf not found on PATH -- run inside 'nix develop'" >&2; exit 1; }; buf generate --template buf.gen.local.yaml
scripts.generate:check:local: before=$(find lib/gen -type f | sort | xargs sha256sum); buf generate --template buf.gen.local.yaml && after=$(find lib/gen -type f | sort | xargs sha256sum); [ "$before" = "$after" ] || { echo "lib/gen/ is out of date -- run 'npm run generate' (web) and 'make proto/generate' (api), then commit the results." >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.generate:check: before=$(find lib/gen -type f | sort | xargs sha256sum); buf generate && after=$(find lib/gen -type f | sort | xargs sha256sum); [ "$before" = "$after" ] || { echo "lib/gen/ is out of date -- run 'npm run generate' (web) and 'make proto/generate' (api), then commit the results." >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.generate:ui-catalog:check: npm run generate:ui-catalog && (git diff --exit-code components/ui/README.md || (echo "components/ui/README.md is out of date -- run 'npm run generate:ui-catalog' and commit the result." && exit 1))
